description: When an old structure satisfies the total unique graph condition, an expansion satisfies the shorter function axiom if and only if it satisfies the full biconditional function axiom.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DefinitionalExtensions.DefinitionPackage.short_iff_full.{u, v, u', v', w}
  {L : FirstOrder.Language} {K : FirstOrder.Language} {M : Type w} [L.Structure M]
  (d : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DefinitionalExtensions.DefinitionPackage L K) {n : ℕ} (f : K.Functions n)
  [(L.sum K).Structure M] [FirstOrder.Language.LHom.sumInl.IsExpansionOn M]
  (h : M ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DefinitionalExtensions.totalUnique (d.functionGraph f)) :
  M ⊨ d.shortFunctionAxiom f ↔ M ⊨ d.functionAxiom f
